observations: Photo 0 shows a small portable keyboard in a pink hard case; keys are visible and appear to be full-size with colored note labels on some keys.
Photo 0 shows the keyboard lid/case open; no brand/model text is clearly readable on the keyboard itself.
Photo 1 shows the keyboard’s pink protective cover/case with a logo that appears to read “HARMONY” and “PRESTON III” (text is partially readable).
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from the side/back with the same “PRESTON III” text visible on the cover; keys are visible behind it.

claims.claim: “If you need a keyboard that will fit into your budget… just Dm me…”
claims.evidence: No budget/price details are provided in the seller text; photos only show a keyboard in a case.

risks.risk: Whether the keyboard actually works (keys, sound, power, volume) and whether any keys are dead or noisy.
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on and playing several keys across the full range (left, middle, right) with the volume working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case for used electronics).

risks.risk: Whether the keyboard includes all required accessories (charger/power adapter, cables, stand/pedals if applicable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of everything included laid out on the floor/table, plus a close-up of the charging port and the exact adapter model label.

risks.risk: Condition issues not obvious in photos (scratches, broken hinges/latches, damaged speaker grille, worn keybed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the hinge/latch area and the speaker/controls area, plus a photo of the underside.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

risks.risk: Model confirmation: the “HARMONY PRESTON III” text is on the cover, but the internal keyboard model may differ.
risks.proof: A photo of the keyboard’s internal label/serial/model sticker (usually on the back/underside) showing the exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the shown model only if confirmed; otherwise treated as generic portable keyboard.

proof_requests: Video: power-on + play test across all keys (left/middle/right) with sound audible.
Photos of included items (charger/adapter and any cables) and a close-up of the charging port.
Close-ups of case hinges/latches and the keyboard underside label/serial/model sticker.
response.reason: The photos identify a portable keyboard in a case and show “HARMONY PRESTON III” on the cover, but they do not prove it works or confirm accessories/condition details that strongly affect price.
